test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_wide_merge (id UInt64, json JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 16)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_rows_to_activate = 1, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_columns_to_activate = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, object_serialization_version = 'v3', object_shared_data_serialization_version = 'advanced', object_shared_data_serialization_version_for_zero_level_parts = 'map_with_buckets'
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_wide_merge SELECT number, toJSONString(mapFromArrays( arrayMap(i -> concat('path_', toString((number * 7 + i * 13) % 200)), range(40)), arrayMap(i -> if(i % 3 = 0, toString(number + i), toString(i)), range(40)))) FROM numbers(200000)

INSERT INTO json_wide_merge SELECT number + 200000, toJSONString(mapFromArrays( arrayMap(i -> concat('path_', toString((number * 11 + i * 17) % 200)), range(40)), arrayMap(i -> if(i % 2 = 0, toString(number * i), toString(i)), range(40)))) FROM numbers(200000)
